races.name: Prestige Security Executive Protection Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Line Of Descent
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally placed to track Alto Alto's expected easy lead, though 25 days since last run and poor trainer form (0/15) create questions

runners_data.name: Begin The Luck
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer with solid recent form, but 10-year-old faces weight burden and lacks a recent win to suggest he can dominate this field

runners_data.name: Delgany Deadline
runners_data.note: Most progressive runner with excellent recent form (2-1-2), benefits from 7lb apprentice claim and Dan Skelton's strong 12/59 strike-rate

runners_data.name: Alto Alto
runners_data.note: Natural leader with no pace pressure expected, but 34-day break and recent inconsistent form raise stamina/sharpness concerns despite class edge

runners_data.name: Angel's Dream
runners_data.note: Lone hold-up horse carrying just 142lbs, needs strong early pace to be effective but showed decent form when third last time

races.paceDynamic: Alto Alto will lead from the start with no other natural front-runners to pressure him, allowing Chris Gordon's gelding to dictate terms at his preferred rhythm. The three prominent runners - Line Of Descent, Begin The Luck, and Delgany Deadline - will track closely behind in a compressed group, while Angel's Dream settles at the back as the sole hold-up horse. This creates a potentially tactical affair where the leader controls the tempo until the prominent racers strike turning for home. The shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the uncontested leader and produce their challenge at the optimal moment.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Alto Alto gets an easy lead and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The 9-year-old uses his 34-day break to full advantage, controlling every yard while the prominent trio arrive too late. His class edge (OR 105) and tactical advantage prove decisive when he finds extra under pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trio Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the three prominent runners coordinate their challenge turning for home
scenarios.body: Line Of Descent or Delgany Deadline uses superior recent form to reel in Alto Alto's diminishing kick. The sustained pressure from multiple challengers breaks the leader's resistance in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with prominent runners pressing Alto Alto
scenarios.body: Angel's Dream gets the perfect setup from the back as the leaders weaken, using his 21lb weight advantage to devastating effect. The Moore team's 14-day freshness and tactical switch pays dividends late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Alto Alto goes very slowly and kicks hard two out
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Delgany Deadline's superior turn of foot (TS 106) proves crucial. Begin The Luck and Line Of Descent struggle to match the acceleration required in a tactical finish.

watchPoints.text: Alto Alto getting a soft lead and still looking strong jumping the last - indicates the tactical advantage has proven decisive
Delgany Deadline travelling smoothly turning for home despite carrying Tristan Durrell's 3lb claim - suggests the progressive 6-year-old is ready to strike
Angel's Dream creeping closer from the back approaching two out - signals the pace has been strong enough for his hold-up style to be effective
Line Of Descent or Begin The Luck pressing Alto Alto early - would create the strong pace that could set up Angel's Dream's late charge
Any jumping errors from the prominent trio tracking Alto Alto - gives the leader extra breathing space and makes his task significantly easier

races.name: Mansell McTaggart Mane Event Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Loriko
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with highest rating but needs others to go hard enough for his finishing kick to be effective

runners_data.name: Ballyeaston
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who should get uncontested lead, strong recent form and Harry Skelton booking is key positive

runners_data.name: Oblemenko
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning quickly from recent run, low in the weights but limited experience over timber

runners_data.name: Shutfrontdoor
runners_data.note: Prominent runner perfectly positioned to track Ballyeaston, recent winner with 7lb claimer taking valuable weight off

runners_data.name: Giddyupadingdong
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor trainer strike-rate, long absence and needs strong pace to be effective from rear

runners_data.name: Moon Monarch
runners_data.note: Returning from 428-day break which is a major concern despite being prominent runner who could track leader

runners_data.name: Khalk'eau Spigao
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced 4-year-old hold-up horse who gets weight allowance but lacks experience in this grade

runners_data.name: Versatile
runners_data.note: Former flat performer switching from all-weather, hold-up type but poor recent form and trainer statistics concern

races.paceDynamic: Ballyeaston will set a controlled pace from the front with Shutfrontdoor and Moon Monarch tracking in behind, creating a sustainable gallop over this sharp 2m trip. The majority of the field are hold-up horses (Loriko, Oblemenko, Giddyupadingdong, Khalk'eau Spigao, Versatile) which means little early pressure on the leader. With Ballyeaston likely unchallenged through the early stages, this sets up perfectly for the prominent runners and those who can travel kindly in behind. This race shape strongly favours horses with prominent/tracking tactics who can position close enough to strike, as the hold-up brigade face a wall of runners ahead when the pace inevitably quickens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Ballyeaston gets an easy lead and isn't pressured until late
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the hold-up horses to make up ground, allowing Ballyeaston to kick clear when Harry Skelton asks. Shutfrontdoor tracks the leader perfectly and provides the main threat if Ballyeaston ties up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine enough for Loriko to unleash a finishing kick
scenarios.body: The higher-rated Loriko times his challenge perfectly as Tristan Durrell finds the gaps that open up ahead. Versatile, despite the poor trainer form, shows his old flat speed to get competitive late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Ballyeaston goes too slow and gets swamped by multiple challengers
scenarios.body: The crawling pace plays into the hands of every hold-up horse as they all get their chance simultaneously. Oblemenko and Khalk'eau Spigao find themselves perfectly positioned to strike as gaps appear everywhere.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Moon Monarch or Shutfrontdoor challenge Ballyeaston from the start
scenarios.body: The unexpected early pressure sets up a true test of stamina that suits horses coming from off the pace. Loriko benefits most from the strong gallop while the early pace-setters all tie up.

watchPoints.text: Ballyeaston getting too easy a lead early - if unopposed through first mile he becomes very hard to peg back
Moon Monarch's fitness after 428 days off - any signs of rustiness early will end his chances immediately
Loriko getting too far back early - needs to be within striking distance turning for home given likely slow pace
Shutfrontdoor and how aggressively Freddie Mitchell positions him - key to whether he can track Ballyeaston or gets shuffled back
The pace through the first half-mile - if genuinely strong it transforms the race for all the hold-up horses

runners_data.name: Bethpage

runners_data.name: Tranquil Sea

runners_data.name: Top Guy

runners_data.name: Fountains Blenhein
runners_data.note: Natural pace-setter will control race but must prove he can last home when challenged

races.paceDynamic: Fountains Blenhein will dictate a steady, sustainable pace from the front with only East India Express, Moveit Like Minnie, Turndlightsdownlow and Elysian Knight likely to track him closely early. The lack of confirmed pace pressure means this will develop into a tactical affair with the tempo building gradually through the back half of the race. With seven hold-up horses including the class acts Double Powerful, Kamsinas, Bethpage and Roger Pol, this race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position handy and kick when the pace lifts, rather than hold-up horses who will face a wall of traffic in a slowly-run staying test.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Prominent Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Fountains Blenhein sets modest fractions and the race becomes a sprint from 2f out
scenarios.body: The prominent runners avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up brigade when the pace finally quickens. East India Express and Moveit Like Minnie benefit most from tactical positioning under quality pilots.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Class Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine enough to create gaps for the back markers to exploit their superior class
scenarios.body: Double Powerful and Kamsinas have the quality edge and their pilots can find racing room when it matters. The class differential tells in a truly-run staying test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Fountains Blenhein crawls early and creates a cavalry charge finish with severe traffic problems
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning crucial and several hold-up horses getting shuffled back. Moveit Like Minnie's proven big-field ability and Nico de Boinville's skill become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Fountain Gate to Post
scenarios.trigger: If Fountains Blenhein maintains his lead throughout and the chasers fail to organize an effective pursuit
scenarios.body: The leader's recent good form and Sam Twiston-Davies' piloting skills prove enough against a disorganized pursuit. Roger Pol's finishing kick gets him closest but falls just short.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Fountains Blenhein goes too slow early - this could create a chaotic cavalry charge finish that becomes a positioning lottery
Monitor whether East India Express and Moveit Like Minnie can secure the crucial prominent positions behind Fountains Blenhein in the early stages
Keep an eye on how quickly Double Powerful and Kamsinas can organize their runs if gaps appear in the straight
Watch for traffic problems developing 3f out when the hold-up horses try to make their moves simultaneously
Observe whether Roger Pol shows any rustiness early after his 190-day absence, particularly at the first few flights

runners_data.name: Northern Poet
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with excellent similar-going record (10/15) but hasn't been seen for 51 days which raises fitness concerns

runners_data.name: Sea Invasion
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with good recent form but struggles to convert placed efforts into wins, needs to improve finishing kick

runners_data.name: Lumi Plugin
runners_data.note: Patient type who has found form recently with two seconds, well-suited to this trip and tactics but needs to find extra gear

runners_data.name: Morfee
runners_data.note: Seasoned hold-up performer with strong stamina credentials, trainer in good form and represents solid each-way value

runners_data.name: Enjoy d'Allen
runners_data.note: Versatile runner who can track the pace, benefits from claiming jockey's allowance but age concerns at 12 years old

runners_data.name: Roe And Co
runners_data.note: Natural leader returning from 98-day break but has excellent course record and wins when allowed to dictate

races.paceDynamic: Roe And Co will take the field along as the sole natural leader, with Sea Invasion and Enjoy d'Allen likely to track him in the early stages. With no genuine pace pressure, Roe And Co can dictate at his own rhythm over this stamina test, creating a sustainable gallop that should suit his patient style. The race will develop into a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial in the home straight. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the solid pace and produce late charges, particularly those with proven stamina credentials over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Roe And Co maintains an even pace without serious early pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The patient types get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks from off the pace. Northern Poet, Morfee and Lumi Plugin can all benefit from the strong gallop and time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Invasion or Enjoy d'Allen can track Roe And Co comfortably and kick when the hold-up horses are still making ground
scenarios.body: The race becomes a battle between the early pace-setters with one of the prominent runners having enough left to hold off late challengers. Their tactical position proves decisive over the stamina-sapping trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Roe And Co faces minimal pressure throughout and can quicken off his own steady pace in the home straight
scenarios.body: The leader gets such an easy time in front that he has plenty left for the finish, stealing a march before the hold-up horses can get organized. His recent wins demonstrate this tactical effectiveness.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow with multiple horses still in contention turning for home
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint finish where class and condition matter more than running style. The strongest finisher on the day prevails regardless of tactics.

watchPoints.text: Roe And Co's fitness after 98 days off - if he weakens early the race shape changes completely
Northern Poet's jumping under pressure - he's been making mistakes lately and needs to be fluent to deliver his finishing kick
Sea Invasion's position early - if he's further back than usual he becomes more dangerous late
The pace through the middle stages - if it becomes crawling slow the hold-up horses lose their advantage
Morfee's jumping rhythm - when he's fluent he's a completely different proposition and can outstay these rivals

races.paceDynamic: Shalfa is the sole confirmed front runner and will face no early pressure, allowing her to dictate terms from the front. Market House and Alibey as prominent runners will track closely behind, but with six hold-up horses including Answer That, Lord Of The Glance, and Dissident in behind, the field will be stretched out. The lack of pace pressure means Shalfa can control fractions and kick when ready, while the hold-up brigade will need the pace to collapse late. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can stay close to the action throughout.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Shalfa Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Shalfa gets an uncontested lead and maintains sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: Her recent winning form and ability to dictate from the front allows her to kick clear when the field comes under pressure. The hold-up horses face too much ground to make up against a controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Market House or Alibey can stay close enough to Shalfa's moderate gallop
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can use their tactical position to strike when Shalfa's effort flattens, avoiding the traffic problems that will hit the hold-up horses. Market House's recent win and consistent form makes him particularly dangerous.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and the field bunches up entering the straight
scenarios.body: Answer That or Lord Of The Glance can use their finishing kick to sweep past tiring leaders in a sprint finish. This requires Shalfa to go too slow early and the prominent runners to lack a decisive turn of foot.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Shot Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to fire and a lesser-fancied runner finds the gaps
scenarios.body: Banksman returning from a break or Chartwell Jock dropping in class could benefit from the tactical setup if the market leaders underperform. The pace shape still needs to suit their hold-up style for this to materialize.

watchPoints.text: Shalfa getting an easy lead - if she faces no early pressure she can control the race completely
Market House's jumping - any mistakes will compromise his prominent position behind the leader
The pace through the first mile - if it's truly crawling the hold-up horses get a better chance
Answer That getting a clear run - he needs luck in running from his hold-up position
How quickly the field spreads out early - a bunched field favours the hold-up horses more

runners_data.name: Notnowlinda

races.paceDynamic: Hecouldbetheone and Goodwin will ensure a strong gallop from the outset, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead over this staying trip. The sustained pace will test stamina reserves through the middle stages, particularly as they negotiate the undulating Plumpton circuit. Hold-up horses Notnowlinda, Alien Storm and The Bellhop can track this honest tempo before launching late challenges. This race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up performers who can capitalise on the early pace battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Hecouldbetheone and Goodwin burn each other out in a prolonged early duel.
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will drain their stamina reserves, allowing the hold-up brigade to sweep past in the final half-mile. Patient tactics and proven stamina become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Goodwin Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Goodwin can establish an uncontested lead with Hecouldbetheone settling behind.
scenarios.body: The Chris Gordon runner gets first run on his rivals and his superior recent form tells in the closing stages. Front-running tactics pay dividends when executed without early pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Prominence Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Oakley's Way and Hiconic can track the pace without getting involved in early skirmishing.
scenarios.body: The prominent pair avoid the pace battle while staying close enough to strike, benefiting from the perfect tactical position. Their racing styles prove optimal for this unfolding scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and turns into a sprint from the last hurdle.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of pure speed rather than stamina, suiting horses with tactical pace. The youngest runner The Bellhop could capitalize on his four-year-old allowance.

watchPoints.text: Hecouldbetheone and Goodwin could set unsustainable fractions if they engage in a prolonged speed duel from the start.
Hiconic returns from 231 days off following wind surgery which creates major fitness and breathing concerns.
Alien Storm carries top weight of 170lbs with a 7lb claimer aboard, creating a difficult weight-carrying assignment.
Notnowlinda's hold-up style suits but the 0-53 form sequence suggests something is seriously amiss.
The Bellhop benefits from Freddie Mitchell's 3lb claim and four-year-old weight allowance in this competitive handicap.

The three prominent runners (Posh Chick, Skye Glance, Steal A Glance) will sit within striking distance, while the hold-up pair (Mirabello, Golden Sanjida) track from the rear. With limited early pace and a relatively short finishing straight at Plumpton, this setup strongly favours prominent racers who can sit handy and kick when the pace lifts, rather than hold-up horses who need a strong gallop to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays modest throughout and the kick comes late
scenarios.body: The handy horses can cover any move and have the tactical advantage over those held up. Posh Chick and Steal A Glance are perfectly positioned to benefit from this likely scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens mid-race and stretches the prominent runners

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Posh Chick goes too slow and it becomes a dash from the last

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field

scenarios.body: The Twiston-Davies/Honeyball combination utilizes perfect tactics to steal a march. Recent winner benefits from confidence and proven course form.

Skye Glance has shown a tendency to fade in the finish which could be exploited if tracking the pace too keenly
Posh Chick's early fractions will determine if hold-up horses get the gallop they need to be competitive
Mirabello needs the 5lb claiming allowance to bridge the class gap after a disappointing last effort over shorter
The betting market will reveal crucial intelligence about the two lightly-raced runners' home work and expectations
